MoveIntoAnExistingNodeV2.clusterID: Cluster ID used to identify a specific cluster.
MoveIntoAnExistingNodeV2.instanceGroupID: Node group ID used to identify a specific node group.
MoveIntoAnExistingNodeV2.inCluster: Whether the node is within the cluster.
MoveIntoAnExistingNodeV2.useInstanceGroupConfig: Applies to out-of-cluster nodes; set to true to use the node group configuration.
MoveIntoAnExistingNodeV2.useInstanceGroupConfigWithDiskInfo: Applies to out-of-cluster nodes; set to true to use the node group configuration (including disk information).
MoveIntoAnExistingNodeV2.installGpuDriver: Whether to install the GPU driver.
